training_source.selection: up to 110 per class from shards 0-23, then fill to 210 per class from shard 24 onward, in source row order

supplementation.selection: Scan the verified DataComp 1/2 training shards and rows in order; add unique images only for the five classes short of 210.

rejected_supplementation.selection: first non-duplicate training images in the old subset manifest order, only for classes below 210

protocol.sampling: seeded uniform reservoir over existing official training files
